description: Registers a Dagster resource with real setup/teardown lifecycle hooks -- the Airflow setup/teardown task pattern equivalent.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Any asset/op declaring required_resource_keys={resource_key} participates in this setup/teardown scope.

setup_callable_path.label: Setup Callable Path
setup_callable_path.description: 'module.path:function_name' to call for setup. Its return value (if any) is passed to teardown_callable_path's callable, if that callable declares a parameter for it. Set at most one of setup_callable_path/setup_command.

setup_command.label: Setup Command
setup_command.description: Shell command to run for setup, via bash -c. Set at most one of setup_callable_path/setup_command.

teardown_callable_path.label: Teardown Callable Path
teardown_callable_path.description: 'module.path:function_name' to call for teardown. Called with setup's return value as its one argument if it declares a parameter, else called with no arguments. Set at most one of teardown_callable_path/teardown_command.

teardown_command.label: Teardown Command
teardown_command.description: Shell command to run for teardown, via bash -c. Runs independently of setup's return value (a shell command can't receive a Python object). Set at most one of teardown_callable_path/teardown_command.

env_vars.label: Env Vars
env_vars.description: Env vars for setup_command/teardown_command's subprocess (merged with the parent process's own environment).

name: ScopedSetupTeardown
